items.title: Warren Buffett Stopped Giving Bill Gates’s Foundation Berkshire Shares. It Just Sold $1 Billion More and Bought a Dollar Store. Here’s When the Rest Runs Out
items.summary: The Gates Foundation Trust sold 2,240,537 Berkshire shares and 6,207,678 Waste Management shares in the third quarter, about $2.4 billion of stock, and opened a $155 million stake in Dollar Tree. It sells Berkshire because Buffett's 2006 letter made it spend each gift, and it sold his June 2025 gift in four equal quarterly slices. This year, for the first time since 2006, no new shares came: Buffett's July and November gifts all went to his family's four foundations.
